You're experiencing society's regulating effect. If you express a belief or opinion that flouts a deeply held social norm, other members of that society will react negatively toward you to reinforce the norm.

It may not be morally wrong to THINK about underage girls sexually, but entertaining a thought often leads to corresponding action. The downvotes are your fellow internet citizens expressing their displeasure at your violation of a contemporary cultural taboo; their public display of negative feedback reinforces the taboo.

It's not a crime to think about it, but most people just don't like hearing it. It makes them uncomfortable to think someone might be thinking this about their kid (or nieces, nephews, grandkids, etc.). Just having an attraction is not the same as actually creeping on kids, of course. But saying you are attracted to children, even if you never intend to act on that, just stirs up a lot of fears people already have about child safety, thanks to the media making it seem like there's a pedophile living next door to every single one of us.
